purpose: Teach: フリーズ/プロトタイプ/ゲラ/内野/地場/からくり/ペンネーム/中高生

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、コンピューターのフリーズに苦労された
lines.en: In those early days, your father struggled mightily with computers freezing up.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective tone. Warm memory surfacing. Slight pause after the opening, as if seeing it again. Steady pace, grounded in affection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商品プロトタイプを自ら試作された
lines.en: Yes. He built every prototype himself.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Simple affirmation of something obvious to him. Respectful cadence — not boasting, just stating fact. Eyes steady.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、ゲラの誤字を見抜く目をお持ちだった
lines.en: He had an eye for catching the smallest typos in proofs — nothing got past him.
lines.style: Admiring softness. The memory carries quiet pride. Slightly slower pace on the admiring detail. Trailing gently into the observation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは内野的な裏方仕事も大事にされた
lines.en: Yes. He understood that the behind-the-scenes work mattered just as much.
lines.style: Careful, thoughtful. Each word carries weight — he's reaching for clarity about something understood but rarely said. Steady breath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、地場の取引先を生涯大切にされた
lines.en: He kept his relationships with local partners alive for his whole life.
lines.style: Deep gratitude in the voice. The word 'lifetime' lands with gentle emphasis. Slower pace. The memory of loyalty spoken with tenderness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは経営にからくりを使われなかった
lines.en: Yes. He never relied on tricks or shortcuts in how he ran things.
lines.style: Steady, clear affirmation. A subtle firmness — he's defending a principle his father held. Measured breath. This matters to him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社内誌でペンネームを使われた事もあった
lines.en: Sometimes he'd even write for the company newsletter under a pen name.
lines.style: A small smile in the voice. The pleasure of a minor secret — something familiar only to those who were there. Light, warm cadence. Slightly amused.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは中高生向け奨学金を設けられた
lines.en: Yes. He started a scholarship fund for junior and high school students.
lines.style: Quiet pride and closure. This fact settles something in the conversation — a legacy made clear. Slower, heavier with meaning. Respectful silence underneath.
